appearance: Dry bright race; earlier qualifying/pit shots cloudy or wet.
layout: Spa-Francorchamps 7.004km F1 loop; station zero is before Bus Stop, not start/finish.
sector_registration: All stations in retained native origin. Approximate full-route zones; individual decor must stay beyond verified protection and runoff.

sectors.name: Bus Stop and Grand Prix pits
sectors.observed_environment: Broad slow chicane, red/yellow kerbs and local paved escape. Grand Prix garage/hospitality bar on right of race direction, covered stands opposite, white event roofs and green banks.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: La Source and old pit descent
sectors.observed_environment: Hairpin opens to dramatic valley descent. Modern grandstand and old endurance pit structures; close red/yellow kerbs, paved outside escape. Do not flatten the descent.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.
sectors.reference_registration: 667.68s directly confirms LaSource approach;671s exit and674s downhill old-pit avenue. Exact source camera stations are approximate; other listed times are older sector context.

sectors.name: Eau Rouge and Raidillon
sectors.observed_environment: From the upstream LaSource exit/old-pit descent, the valley, large covered stand on the left bank toward EauRouge and forested ridge are visible. These approach views do not establish the exact compression, Raidillon crest, or a gabled chalet at EauRouge.
sectors.placement_confidence: Approach context only. Prior205.90/667.68s claims of direct EauRouge evidence were incorrect; both show LaSource. Use retained map/profile for station geometry and independently verify close landmark identity/footprint.

sectors.name: Kemmel, Les Combes and Malmedy
sectors.observed_environment: Long uphill forest-lined straight with narrow grass and Armco. Open spectator slopes and brown gravel/soil outside braking/chicane area; dense mixed conifers beyond.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.
sectors.reference_registration: 676s directly confirms Kemmel vegetation/protection vocabulary; exact station within the straight is not surveyed.

sectors.name: Bruxelles, Speakers Corner and Pouhon
sectors.observed_environment: Descending wooded corners with broad red/yellow kerbs, outside grass/gravel and constrained advertised walls. Tree-covered banks enclose lower valley, not a flat plain.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Fagnes, Campus and Paul Frère
sectors.observed_environment: Forest sequence with corner-specific gravel traps, green/red painted margins and small white track facilities. Protection follows runoff edge, never continuous blocks across paved escape.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Blanchimont return
sectors.observed_environment: Fast rising forest corridor, red/yellow edge kerbs, narrow grass verges and metal Armco/catch fencing; broad spectator hillside at return toward Bus Stop.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

SPW 0.5m 2021–22 MNT is authoritative bare-earth candidate; identify height payload rather than reading coloured map export. Bridges removed from MNT require deck masks. Historical README fine survey is not retained.

terrain.racing_deck_correction: Separate independentlydigitized primary Formula1roadprofile now replaces contaminated/coarseGLO90 racingprofile. Landscapegrid remains separatelysourced. Post2022runoff/grandstands differ from2016diagram, but same7.004kmracingline. EauRouge/Raidillon grade registered to namedways; constructionverticaltransitions not surveyed.

authoring_constraints: Use mapped building footprints and match rooflines, structural supports, facade depth and stepped volumes; names alone do not establish likeness.
Place grass/gravel/asphalt runoff per registered corner, with protection at outside edge; do not fill escape areas with independent tiles/blocks.
Road, kerbs, shoulder and protection share smooth station sampling; kerbs only in explicit ranges.
Maintain venue-specific vegetation around complete route, preserving long sightlines/open water where present.
Reference pixels remain ignored; generate geometry and materials only.
quality_gates: Matching cockpit frame at each sector and every braking/turn sequence.
Oblique view of runoff shapes, architectural footprints and terrain.
Full lap motion review for edge smoothness, floating objects, protection gaps and missing surroundings.
Luna high reviewer must evaluate rendered evidence, not this recipe.

braking_markers.selection: Major braking approaches only; short linked corners use 100/50 m sets. No boards added to flat-out sweeps solely because the curvature detector counted a bend.

barrier_branding.source_policy: Only the selected reviewed palette/identities are reproduced with original typesetting. Unsupported or varying identities use neutral PanelWhite; no reference pixels are shipped.

ranges.observation: White/black game-event panels line the Grand Prix pit straight. The purple QATAR pit-lane frame is not evidence for a purple race-wall band.
The opposite Grand Prix straight wall also has white event panels.
Short white event-panel runs beside the old/endurance pit buildings approaching Eau Rouge.
Yellow PIRELLI panels on the braking-zone end of the forest-lined Kemmel/Les Combes approach; retain exposed Armco earlier on the straight.
